name: Apothecary Hummel drops the CoA level-60 loot at live rates
contract: As on live CoA, Apothecary Hummel rolls the five level-60 Love is in the Air necks at 2% each and Forever-Lovely Rose, Vile Fumigator's Mask and The Heartbreaker at 5% each instead of a guaranteed stock level-80 neck, so about 22% of kills yield a rare or better item.

steps.label: About 22% of Apothecary Hummel kills yield a rare or better item, not every kill
